newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MARLBOROUGH IN GOLD/COPPER JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: MARLBOROUGH IN GOLD/COPPER JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Marlborough Gold Mines NL said on Thursday it had agreed to form a joint venture with Coolgardie Gold NL to explore for gold and copper in Queensland.
Marlborough said it had accepted an offer from Coolgardie that means Coolgardie may earn up to 80 percent in the South Connors Arch project, which includes seven gold and copper mine targets.
Coolgardie will spend up to A$4 million on exploration over three years to earn the stake, Marlborough said.

"In the current market, which is very adverse for exploration and fund raising, it was essential for Marlborough to involve a joint venture partner at South Connors Arch," Marlborough managing director Stephen Stone said in a statement.
The project area covers 5,040 square km and comprises seven exploration permits and 16 exploration permit applications.
Marlborough is 31 percent owned by Perth-based Dragon Mining NL
